verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a genuine first-party bulk capability in the Product Feed API. POST /v1/ingestions accepts up to 200 items per call for asynchronous processing, DELETE removes up to 200 products per call, and GET reports per-product status and errors. This is the platform's own capability, not a workaround, but it is limited to agentic-commerce catalog sync; the core payments APIs and MCP tools shown are all single-item. missing for 10: bulk operations on payments/modifications (batch refunds, captures, cancels), bulk payouts or account management, bulk actions exposed via the MCP server, independent or hands-on corroboration.
